description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.2. It includes methods to add columns to existing tables, insert records into module and menu tables, and manage permissions related to maintenance and data purging functionalities.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database migration for version 4.2 of OrangeHRM, responsible for altering schemas, inserting permissions, and setting up menu items.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps such as adding columns, inserting modules and permissions, and creating menu items.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to insert menu items into the database with specified hierarchy, labels, and settings.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the screen ID based on the action URL, used to link menu items to screens.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the migration, which is '4.2'.
